[[File:Baudo-class_star_yacht.jpg|thumb|250px|A ''Baudo''-class luxury yacht]]

'''Luxury yachts''' were [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that catered to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] rich and prestigious citizens. The ''[[Chancellor Fillorean]]'' was one such yacht, which carried thirty passengers, and housed full luxury accommodations for each guest. The [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] was another well known luxury yacht, owned by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. The [[Baudo-class star yacht|''Baudo''-class]] was another model of luxury yacht.
